description.value: The study examined neural mechanisms of cognitive regulation of alcohol craving and negative emotion in individuals with alcohol use disorder using fMRI.

spans.text: To address these questions, we used fMRI to scan individuals with AUD while they completed the Regulation of Craving (ROC) and Emotion Regulation (ER) tasks.

description.value: Two-visit outpatient study of individuals with AUD.

spans.text: ventral striatum
VS/sgACC and vmPFC/OFC in the ROC task and amygdala in the ER task were selected as a priori regions of interest (ROIs)

To do this, the amygdala ROI was defined using an anatomical mask, while the VS/sgACC and vmPFC/OFC ROIs were defined using spherical ROIs (r=6mm) centered around peaks previously observed during regulation of craving in cigarette smokers (VS/sgACC: −3, 11, −2; vmPFC/OFC: 0, 56, −2; ( 40 )).
